novel_features.name: Today dashboard
novel_features.description: One screen with the Hebrew date, parsha, holiday, today's zmanim with the next one highlighted, the Omer count, and today's Chitas and Rambam.
novel_features.rationale: Joins Chabad.org's zmanim webservice, its daily-study feed, and local calendar math that no single Chabad.org page combines.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent needs everything about today's Jewish day in one structured call instead of four lookups.
novel_features.group: Your Jewish day at a glance

novel_features.name: Next zman countdown
novel_features.description: The next halachic times and how many minutes until each, rolling into tomorrow's dawn, with an exit-code mode for automation.
novel_features.rationale: Flattens two days of Chabad.org zmanim in the location's time zone and computes time-until locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to answer 'when is the next zman' or to gate a Shabbat-mode trigger without re-implementing day rollover.
novel_features.group: Your Jewish day at a glance

novel_features.name: Weekly bulletin block
novel_features.description: A copy-paste weekly block for newsletters and shul signage (--format md|plain, --days N): Shabbat times with week-over-week change, parsha, Hebrew date, Mevarchim and Rosh Chodesh notices, and upcoming holidays, for one or more locations.
novel_features.rationale: Composes Chabad.org's Shabbat/holiday groups, day records, and local molad math into one block no Chabad.org page produces.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when someone needs this week's Shabbat announcement text, not raw times.

novel_features.name: Holiday-season lookahead
novel_features.description: Every fast, erev Yom Tov, Yom Tov end, Rosh Chodesh, Shabbat Mevarchim and first Chanukah candle in the next N days, each with the times it needs (candle lighting, light-from-flame, fast start and end, chametz deadlines); --all adds minor and Chassidic dates.
novel_features.rationale: Scans a window of Chabad.org day records and attaches the event-specific zmanim each day carries.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to plan the coming weeks around holidays and fasts with Chabad.org's exact times.

novel_features.name: Family occasions list
novel_features.description: Keep a local list of family yahrzeits, Hebrew birthdays, anniversaries and bar/bat-mitzvah dates and see which fall in the coming days.
novel_features.rationale: Stores people's Hebrew-date events locally and expands them to Gregorian dates, which the one-person-at-a-time Chabad.org calculators cannot do.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when the question is 'whose yahrzeit or Hebrew birthday is coming up' across many people.

narrative.headline: Chabad.org's zmanim, Shabbat and holiday times, and daily Chitas in your terminal, plus a today dashboard, next-zman countdown, and weekly bulletin.
narrative.value_prop: chabad-pp-cli uses the same times Chabad.org publishes, following Chabad custom (18-minute candle lighting, 40 in Jerusalem, and the Chabad Shabbat-end time), where generic calendars use Hebcal defaults. Run `today` for the whole Jewish day on one screen, `next` for a countdown to the next zman, `bulletin` for this week's newsletter block, and `ahead` for the holidays and fasts coming up. Every command works with --json for scripts and agents.
narrative.auth_narrative: No account or API key. The CLI calls Chabad.org's public zmanim webservices and daily-study feed. Set a default location once with `chabad-pp-cli locations use <ZIP or city>`.

troubleshoots.symptom: No location given and no default set
troubleshoots.fix: Pass --location 11213 (a ZIP or city name), or save one with: chabad-pp-cli locations use 11213

troubleshoots.symptom: A city name matched the wrong place
troubleshoots.fix: Run: chabad-pp-cli locations --query "<city>" and reuse the exact Value it returns (or city:<Value> for a city id) as your location

troubleshoots.symptom: zmanim returns fewer days than requested
troubleshoots.fix: Chabad.org caps one call at about 180 days; split long ranges into several --from/--to calls (holidays and ahead do this for you)

troubleshoots.symptom: HTTP 500 or an XML error body from a webservice
troubleshoots.fix: The service needs Accept: application/json, which the CLI sends; if you call it yourself, add that header

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when a user or agent needs Jewish calendar facts as Chabad.org publishes them: zmanim, Shabbat and Yom Tov candle-lighting and end times, the weekly parsha, holiday dates, Hebrew dates, the Omer, yahrzeits and Hebrew birthdays, or the daily Chitas and Rambam schedule. It is the right choice for newsletters, shul display boards, Shabbat-mode automation, and quick 'when is Shabbat' answers that should follow Chabad custom.
anti_triggers: Do not use it for Chabad.org articles, Torah texts, Jewish History entries or Laws & Customs text; those pages are not part of this CLI
Do not use it for Daf Yomi or Mishna Yomi; Chabad.org's feeds here do not publish them
Do not use it as a halachic ruling; for questions of practice, ask a rabbi
Do not use it to find or contact a Chabad center
